title: Replace the placeholder web tests for auth and files
description:
`web/test/data/auth.test.ts` and `web/test/data/files.test.ts` contain seven `assert.ok(true)` bodies with comments such as "Test would need proper module setup… Simplified for now". `web/src/data/files.ts` therefore has no real tests, and these files are also absent from the `test:flow` script.

Done when: each placeholder is either a real test of observable behaviour or removed, and the files run in CI.
